name: print-social-national-science-day-stories-indigo-gradient-orbiting-planets
title: National Science Day story set on indigo gradients with orbiting planets and giant coloured numerals
whatItIs: Four vertical indigo-to-purple gradient story cards with illustrated orbiting ringed planets, dot-grid texture, bold multi-colour condensed headlines ('National Science Day', '28 February'), a giant numeral '28' as a hero element, and green 'Swipe Up' buttons.
whatItMeans: Playful and cosmic; orbiting planets and a giant date numeral make an academic observance day feel like a fun space adventure.
techniques: Illustrate simple ringed planets as a space motif.
Make the date itself a giant hero graphic on one card.
Colour each letter of a headline differently for a playful rainbow effect.

vocabulary.definition: A number rendered extremely large as the focal graphic.
A headline where each letter or word uses a different colour.
